subject: Recap: Pilot cost assumptions, credit ask, and next steps (GreenLeaf)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@greenleaf.bio>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Pilot cost assumptions, credit ask, and next steps (GreenLeaf)

Hi Elena — great to meet you and the GreenLeaf team today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed path to get your pilot unstuck: 

What we heard from you:
- Pilot scope: 2-week functional validation + 4-week usage window for business metrics (total ~6 weeks).
- Expected consumption during pilot: 8–12M input+output tokens/month (mostly chat-like traffic, peaks during business hours).
- Primary success criteria: latency < 400ms p95 for short context, generation quality on curated prompts, and no regressions on PII handling.
- Budget range (internal): $8k–$12k for the pilot (you said you can stretch to $15k with justification).

Our cost posture and proposal:
- Suggested unit economics target for the pilot: $900 per 1M tokens (this is the blended hosted rate for the recommended low-latency model + mild quantization).
- Based on 10M tokens baseline that maps to ~$9,000 over a 30-day window.
- To give you headroom for spikes and A/B runs, we propose a one-time credits top-up of $15,000 (covers ~16.6M tokens at $900/1M).

Attachments: I attached a short pilot plan (greenleaf-pilot-plan-v1.pdf) and a usage estimate spreadsheet (greenleaf-usage-estimate.xlsx) that break this down by daily hourly distribution and worst-case burn scenarios.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Confirm that 8–12M tokens/month is still the expected range (or revise).
2) If agreed, I’ll request approval for a $15k credit and set the credit expiry to 60 days from issuance.
3) Schedule a technical onboarding with our Solutions Engineer (30–45 min) to verify telemetry hooks and test prompts.
4) We’ll track burn weekly and do a 2-week check-in to decide go/no-go for expansion.

Can you confirm (a) expected monthly tokens and (b) whether the proposed $15k credit would cover internal approval on your side? I’ll loop legal/ops in after your confirmation.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@greenleaf.bio>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Pilot cost assumptions, credit ask, and next steps (GreenLeaf)

Laura — thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from our side: 
- Our estimate is roughly 10M tokens/month for the pilot window (more concentrated on Q&A flows).
- Budget: we have operational leeway up to $12k; pushing to $15k requires a brief internal review but is possible.
- We absolutely want the 2-week check-in cadence you suggested.

Can you confirm the credit would only be usable for hosted API consumption (not marketplace credits)? Also, would the credit expiration be 60 days from issuance as you described? If so, I think we can accept the $15k ask as long as you can approve it on your end. 

Availability: I can do the tech sync next Tue (Nov 2) 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed (Nov 3) 13:00–14:00 PT.

Thanks —
Elena
CTO (acting), GreenLeaf Bio
elena.morales@greenleaf.bio
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap: Pilot cost assumptions, credit ask, and next steps (GreenLeaf) — credit approval ask

Folks — forwarding the thread from GreenLeaf. Short ask: can we approve a one-time $15,000 credit for GreenLeaf Bio to cover pilot burn? Rationale below.

Why this deal: GreenLeaf is a high-priority strategic prospect in biotech—low friction integration, likely POC -> paid pilot -> 12–18 month expansion (potential ARR $150k+ within 12 months if the pilot shows quality/regulatory fit).

Numbers in the attached spreadsheet show: 
- Expected pilot baseline: 10M tokens (monthly) => ~$9k at $900/1M tokens.
- Proposed credit: $15k to provide ~70% headroom during testing, A/B runs, and concurrency spikes.
- Credit expiry: 60 days from issuance.

Guardrails: credit to be applied only to Redwood hosted API usage; not valid for private or marketplace charges. We’ll enable per-key alerts and weekly burn reports; if they exceed 20M tokens in 2 weeks we’ll pause and require go/no-go.

Can you sign off? If yes, I’ll issue the credit and propose Nov 2 for the tech sync with our SE.

Thanks —
Laura

Attachment: greenleaf-usage-estimate.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap: Pilot cost assumptions, credit ask, and next steps (GreenLeaf) — APPROVED

Laura — approved. One-time $15,000 hosted-API credit for GreenLeaf Bio. Approvals and conditions below: 
- Credit amount: $15,000 (applies only to redwood.ai hosted inference API consumption).
- Expiration: 60 days from issuance.
- Guardrails: billing team to set per-key caps and weekly email burn summary to the account team. If consumption > 20M tokens in any 14-day window, pause consumption and require AE + CS review.
- Reporting: request weekly burn snapshot to rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai and laura.bennett@redwood.ai.

Laura — please issue the credit and confirm the DocuSign/MPA path for the pilot terms (we should get a countersigned MPA before conversion to paid).

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
